tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- Steps show a complete exploration of the Magento 1 Admin "Manage Products" grid.
- We saw login from catalog_product URL, analysis of grid structure, mapping of all filter controls, Search/Reset buttons, pagination controls, mass actions, row checkboxes, and Edit links.
- No actual filter inputs were executed in the trace, but the final summary gives precise DOM IDs/names and recommended robust selectors.
- Previous tool version failed specifically because deterministic Search click used `button[title='Search']`, which did not resolve; we now know Search is more robustly targeted by `#productGrid_search` (and Reset by `#productGrid_reset`).

Task Definition:
- Purpose: Provide a reusable tool that, given filter and pagination parameters, will:
  1) Navigate to the admin catalog product grid (auto-login if needed via provided credentials).
  2) Fill in all requested filter fields (ID range, name, type, attribute set, SKU, price range + currency, qty range, visibility, status, website).
  3) Click Search using a robust selector to apply filters.
  4) Optionally adjust pagination (page number and page size).
  5) Optionally select a specific product row checkbox and/or click its Edit link by product ID.
  6) Extract the resulting grid HTML/text so the calling agent can parse product data.
- The tool is single-purpose: demonstrate search/filter + pagination + row actions on this grid.

Action Plan:
1) Navigation: go directly to `http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/`.
2) (Implicit) Login handling: because the framework says auth is handled outside and credentials are known, we do NOT script login in this tool; the environment ensures we land on the grid. If a login screen appears at runtime, that's for the outer system, not this tool.
3) Optionally clear filters first via Reset Filter button (#productGrid_reset) when `reset_before_search` flag is true to ensure deterministic state.
4) Fill each filter field using stable CSS selectors based on discovered IDs/names:
   - ID from/to: `#productGrid_filter_entity_id_from`, `#productGrid_filter_entity_id_to`.
   - Name: `#productGrid_filter_name`.
   - Type: `#productGrid_filter_type_id` (select by visible text).
   - Attribute set: `#productGrid_filter_set_name` (select by visible text).
   - SKU: `#productGrid_filter_sku`.
   - Price from/to: `#productGrid_filter_price_from`, `#productGrid_filter_price_to`.
   - Price currency: `#productGrid_filter_price_currency` (select by visible text like 'USD').
   - Qty from/to: `#productGrid_filter_qty_from`, `#productGrid_filter_qty_to`.
   - Visibility: `#productGrid_filter_visibility`.
   - Status: `#productGrid_filter_status`.
   - Websites: `#productGrid_filter_websites`.
5) Click Search button via `#productGrid_search` (fixing earlier failure that used `button[title='Search']`). If that deterministic selector ever fails in practice, an agent step could be added, but here we keep it deterministic per instructions and discovered IDs.
6) After results load, apply pagination controls when requested:
   - Change page size via `#productGrid .pager select[name='limit']` by visible text (e.g., '50').
   - Change page number via `#productGrid .pager input[name='page']` followed by Enter key press on that input.
   - Alternatively, click Next/Previous pager links when requested using `.pager a[title='Next page']` or `.pager a:contains('Previous')`. We'll parameterize this via `pager_direction`.
7) Optionally select a specific row checkbox by product id using `input[type='checkbox'][value='{product_id}']`.
8) Optionally click the Edit link for a given product id using `a[href*='/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}']`.
9) Finally, extract the page content (grid HTML) for the caller.

Variable Identification:
All filters are optional. Parameters should match underlying form field semantics:
- `entity_id_from`, `entity_id_to`: numeric strings for ID range.
- `name`: text for Name filter.
- `type_id`: visible text of the product type select (e.g., 'Simple Product', 'Configurable Product').
- `attribute_set_name`: visible text of attribute set select (e.g., 'Default').
- `sku`: text for SKU filter.
- `price_from`, `price_to`: numeric strings.
- `price_currency`: visible text in currency dropdown (e.g., 'USD') if selectable.
- `qty_from`, `qty_to`: numeric strings.
- `visibility`: one of the visibility option texts.
- `status`: 'Enabled' or 'Disabled'.
- `websites`: visible text of the Website option (e.g., 'Main Website').
- `reset_before_search` (bool, optional): whether to click Reset Filter before filling filters.
- Pagination:
  - `page_number`: desired page number string.
  - `page_size`: one of '20','30','50','100','200'.
  - `pager_direction`: 'next' or 'previous' if using relative nav instead of direct page_number.
- Row actions:
  - `select_product_id`: product ID string for checkbox selection.
  - `edit_product_id`: product ID string whose Edit link should be clicked.

Step Optimization:
- We avoid repeated analyse_page_content calls; selectors are known.
- We use direct navigation to catalog_product URL instead of clicking through menus.
- We rely on specific IDs like #productGrid_search and #productGrid_reset to avoid ambiguous selectors (`button[title='Search']` previously failed because it found no element or multiple elements). These should match exactly one element.
- For pagination and row actions, we use precise attribute selectors (checkbox value, href pattern) that are stable across page loads.
- We do not include any unnecessary sorting or toolbar interactions beyond pagination as required by the task.
- No agent steps are strictly needed because all elements have deterministic selectors; this both simplifies the tool and avoids prior agentic failures.

Because the original failure involved the Search button selector, the critical fix is Step 'click Search' using `cssSelector: '#productGrid_search'` rather than `button[title='Search']`. If that ID were missing, an agent step could search by text, but logs and analysis show it exists.

PASS 1 deterministic steps below, with inputs wired to parameters.
name: tool_search_products.v5
description: Search and filter products in the Magento admin Manage Products grid using all available filters (ID range, name, type, attribute set, SKU, price range/currency, qty range, visibility, status, website) plus pagination, then return the resulting grid contents. Fixes previous failures by using robust selectors (#productGrid_search, #productGrid_reset) instead of brittle button[title='Search']. Assumes admin session already authenticated or will be auto-logged-in via standard login form.

steps.description: Open Magento Admin Manage Products grid page.
Wait for the product grid, filters, and toolbar to fully load after navigation or potential auto-login redirect.
Optionally reset all filters to default state before applying new ones. Caller controls via reset_before_search flag.
Set ID range lower bound filter (From). Leave blank if no value provided.
Set ID range upper bound filter (To). Leave blank if no value provided.
Set Name filter text.
Select product Type filter option by visible text.
Select Attribute Set filter by visible text.
Set SKU filter text.
Set Price range lower bound (From).
Set Price range upper bound (To).
Select Price currency by visible text, e.g., 'USD'.
Set Qty range lower bound (From).
Set Qty range upper bound (To).
Select product Visibility filter option.
Select product Status filter option (Enabled/Disabled).
Select Website filter option by visible text.
Click Search to apply all configured filters using robust selector #productGrid_search (fixing previous failure with button[title='Search']).
Wait for grid to refresh with filtered results.
Optionally change grid page size (View per page) if page_size is provided.
Optionally set pager page number input to navigate directly to a specific page.
Submit page number change by pressing Enter on page input.
Optionally click Next page in pager when pager_direction is 'next'.
Optionally click Previous page in pager when pager_direction is 'previous'.
Optionally select checkbox for the specified product ID row.
Optionally click Edit link for the specified product ID row to open product edit page.
Wait for any navigation (e.g., after clicking Edit) or grid refresh to complete.
Extract resulting page content after performing all configured actions.
steps.goal: Capture the HTML/text of the current Magento Manage Products grid or product edit page after filters, pagination, and row actions so the caller can parse product data or confirm navigation.

input_schema.name: entity_id_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound for product ID filter (maps to input name entity_id[from]). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: entity_id_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound for product ID filter (maps to input name entity_id[to]). Leave empty to skip.

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Product Name filter text (input[name='name']).

input_schema.name: type_id
input_schema.description: Product Type filter visible text, e.g., 'Simple Product', 'Configurable Product' (select[name='type_id']).

input_schema.name: attribute_set_name
input_schema.description: Attribute Set filter visible text, e.g., 'Default', 'Electronics' (select[name='set_name']).

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: SKU filter text (input[name='sku']).

input_schema.name: price_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound for Price filter (input name price[from]).

input_schema.name: price_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound for Price filter (input name price[to]).

input_schema.name: price_currency
input_schema.description: Visible text for price currency selector (select[name='price[currency]']), e.g., 'USD'.

input_schema.name: qty_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound for Qty filter (input name qty[from]).

input_schema.name: qty_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound for Qty filter (input name qty[to]).

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visibility filter visible text, e.g., 'Catalog, Search' (select[name='visibility']).

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Status filter (select[name='status']).

input_schema.name: websites
input_schema.description: Websites filter visible text, e.g., 'Main Website' (select[name='websites']).

input_schema.name: reset_before_search
input_schema.description: If true, click Reset Filter before applying new filters.

input_schema.name: page_number
input_schema.description: Page number to navigate to via pager input[name='page']. Leave empty to stay on current page.

input_schema.name: page_size
input_schema.description: View per page size for the grid (pager select[name='limit']).

input_schema.name: pager_direction
input_schema.description: Relative pager navigation: 'next' clicks Next page, 'previous' clicks Previous page. Ignored if page_number is provided.

input_schema.name: select_product_id
input_schema.description: Product ID whose row checkbox should be checked (input[type='checkbox'][value='{product_id}']).

input_schema.name: edit_product_id
input_schema.description: Product ID whose Edit link should be clicked (a[href*='/catalog_product/edit/id/{product_id}']).
